description: This file implements a row-wise pruning operation for tensors, specifically designed for sparsity in weight matrices using a mask. It includes helper functions and the main function '_rowwise_prune' that returns pruned weights and a mapping tensor.

methods.name: _rowwise_prune_helper
methods.description: Helper template function that performs the actual pruning operation, returning pruned tensor and mapping based on a boolean mask.

methods.name: _rowwise_prune
methods.description: Main function that validates inputs and calls the helper to perform row-wise pruning, returning pruned weights and index mapping tensors.
